Name: Uzzi, Son of Bukki
Summary: Son of Bukki and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:5; 1 Chronicles 6:51: Son of Bukki and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzzi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
